Why Today Matters

Today, 22nd of March matters because it marks the day someone truly special came into this world — and somehow, I get to know you, love you, and celebrate you.

It is more than just a birthday. It is a reminder that your life is a gift, not just to me, but to everyone lucky enough to cross your path.

So today, I am not just celebrating your age. I am celebrating you, our existence, your growth, your heart, and everything you are becoming.

Happy 25th, my love 🎂
